$summary: Foreground roles — text and icon colours, plus the label that sits on a filled accent.

theme.fg.primary.summary: The default, highest-emphasis text and icon color.
use: Body copy, headings, and meaningful (non-decorative) icons.

theme.fg.secondary.summary: Lower-emphasis text — supporting copy that should not compete with primary content.

theme.fg.muted.summary: The lowest-emphasis foreground — placeholders and decorative icons only.
dont: Body-size text on theme.bg.muted — falls to AA-large only there; use theme.fg.secondary for readable body text on that background.
use: A decorative icon that carries no meaning on its own.

theme.fg.on-accent.summary: White text/icon color for use on a filled, saturated role background.
use: Label on a primary (accent) or destructive (danger) button.
Icon on a filled accent or danger badge.
dont: On theme.success-role.bg or theme.warning-role.bg — both are known contrast gaps (see Known gaps). Use the role's subtle/fg pairing for text instead.
